## The Problem {.project-section-heading}

Each Power BI HTML Content dashboard was being built from scratch. Colors,
fonts, abbreviations, and threshold logic drifted from one report to the
next, and every new visual re-learned the same Power BI WebView rendering
gotchas — locale decimal separators in SVG coordinates, string-escaping
rules, sizing inside a fixed card.


## The Solution {.project-section-heading}

I built a standards library that turns those lessons into reusable
building blocks. The key constraint it is designed around: one HTML
Content visual renders one measure, so every card in a dashboard section
lives inside a single DAX measure assembled from a shared shell.

### What's in the library

- **Design tokens** — the single source of truth for colors, typography,
  and spacing, plus consistent threshold colors (green / amber / red)
  with a configurable "high is good" direction
- **A dashboard shell** — a starting measure that injects CSS once,
  defines the grid, and hosts any number of cards, plus a master-detail
  variant
- **Seven visual templates, each with a spec** — KPI card, donut, bar +
  line, progress/budget bar, data table, gauge/dial, and a dark/light
  theme toggle; every template has a clearly marked configure block
- **Platform notes** — documented Power BI WebView constraints, JavaScript
  capabilities, filtering patterns, and DAX string-escaping rules, so the
  next builder reads them before hitting them

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 8
flowchart LR
    A[Design Tokens] --> B[Dashboard Shell<br>CSS + Grid]
    C[Visual Templates<br>KPI, Donut, Table...] --> B
    B --> D[One DAX Measure]
    D --> E[Power BI<br>HTML Content Visual]
```

### Proven on real dashboards

The library ships with a worked example — a treatment-cost dashboard
built as a 450+ line single measure — and new reports start from a
template and a checklist rather than a blank measure.

### What Changed for the Business

- **Visual consistency** across executive dashboards without a design review
  on every report
- **Faster starts** — copy the shell, pick visuals, fill in the `TODO`s
- **Lower rework** — known rendering pitfalls are written down next to
  the templates that avoid them


## Technical Stack {.project-section-heading}

| Component | Technology | Purpose |
|:----------|:-----------|:--------|
| Templates | DAX | Measures that emit HTML/SVG strings |
| Rendering | Power BI HTML Content visual | Host for the generated markup |
| Standards | Markdown specs, design tokens | Source of truth for look and behavior |
